title: 第2章 送情报
slug: 穿越民国获得每日签到系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

肚子里忽然传来一阵响亮的“咕噜噜——”声，突兀地打破了小屋的寂静。

叶静姝一怔，才后知后觉地想起。

自己最开始出门，是为了找东西填肚子。

刚才一番惊心动魄，又是接情报、躲伪军、激活系统。

折腾到现在，她一口吃的还没沾过。

饥饿感瞬间席卷上来，搅得胃里发空。

她这才抬手，心念微动。

掌心立刻多了两块沉甸甸的粗面饼。

还有一盒小巧温润的冻疮膏。

面饼带着朴实的粮食香气，光是闻着，就让人一阵心安。

叶静姝不敢狼吞虎咽，怕空太久的肠胃受不住。

只得掰下一小块面饼，含在嘴里，用唾液慢慢浸润软化。

等它变得绵软一些，才敢轻轻嚼几下，缓缓咽下。

一口，又一口。

粗糙却实在的面香在嘴里散开，暖意一点点落进胃里。

原本发虚的身体也渐渐有了些力气。

吃完一块，她把另一块仔细收进空间，又拿起那盒冻疮膏。

看着自己红肿开裂、布满冻疮的手，她轻轻抹上一层药膏。

清凉的触感瞬间缓解了刺痛。

有吃的，有药膏，有空间，有系统。

叶静姝靠在冰冷的墙上，轻轻吐出一口气。

伸手摸了摸炕，冰凉的芦苇席硌得掌心发疼，下面连层薄褥子都没有。

躺上去怕是半夜都暖不热身子。

她摸了摸贴身口袋，几张皱巴巴的法币角票。

还有一小把铜元——是她现有的全部家当了。

现在当务之急得把炕烧热。

她拢了拢旧棉袄，踩着胡同里冻得发硬的土路，几步走到隔壁。

王阿婆家的院门是两扇老旧木板门。

边角都磨得发毛，门缝里还漏着丝丝寒气。

她抬手，用指节轻轻在门板上敲了三下。

“笃、笃、笃。”

“王阿婆，在家吗？”

声音不大，在安静的胡同里却格外清晰。

随着脚步声渐近，门吱呀一声开了，王阿婆裹着青布头巾，眯眼笑道：

“静姝啊，冷坏了吧？快进来。”

Page (1/3)

Suddenly, there was a loud "Gurgulu——" sound coming from my stomach, which suddenly broke the silence of the hut.

Ye Jingshu was startled for a moment, then remembered it belatedly.

I first went out to find something to fill my stomach.

It was thrilling just now, and it was about receiving intelligence, hiding from the puppet troops, and activating the system.

So far, she has not touched a single bite.

The feeling of hunger swept over me instantly, making my stomach feel empty.

Only then did she raise her hand, her thoughts moving slightly.

Immediately there were two heavy pieces of thick dough in the palm of my hand.

There is also a small box of mild frostbite cream.

The bread has an earthy grain aroma, and just smelling it makes people feel at ease.

Ye Jingshu didn't dare to devour it, fearing that her stomach would not be able to bear it after being empty for too long.

I had to break off a small piece of dough, hold it in my mouth, and slowly soak it with saliva to soften it.

Wait until it becomes softer before you dare to chew it a few times and swallow it slowly.

One bite, and another.

The rough but solid aroma of noodles spreads in your mouth, and the warmth falls into your stomach bit by bit.

The originally weak body gradually gained some strength.

After finishing one piece, she carefully put the other piece into the space, and then picked up the box of chilblain ointment.

Looking at her red, swollen, cracked, and frostbite-covered hands, she lightly applied a layer of ointment.

The cool touch instantly relieves the sting.

There is food, ointment, space, and a system.

Ye Jingshu leaned against the cold wall and breathed out gently.

He reached out and touched the kang. The cold reed mat made his palms ache, and there was not even a thin mattress underneath.

I'm afraid I won't be able to warm myself up even if I lie down in it in the middle of the night.

She touched her pocket and found a few crumpled French dime notes.

There was also a small handful of copper coins—all she had now.

The most urgent thing now is to heat up the kang.

She gathered up her old cotton-padded jacket, stepped on the frozen dirt road in the alley, and walked to the next door in a few steps.

The courtyard door of Grandma Wang's house is two old wooden doors.

The corners were frayed, and there was still a bit of cold air leaking from the cracks in the door.

She raised her hand and knocked lightly on the door panel three times with her knuckles.

"Tuk, Tuk, Tuk."

"Grandma Wang, are you at home?"

The sound was not loud, but it was extremely clear in the quiet alley.

As the footsteps approached, the door creaked open. Grandma Wang, wrapped in a green cloth headscarf, narrowed her eyes and smiled:

"Jingshu, are you feeling cold? Come in quickly."
